name: What information do I need before I ask for a quote?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before I ask for a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring photos of the room, rough measurements, a wish list, and any examples of styles you like. If you already know what is not working—storage, layout, lighting, or damage—sharing that early helps the contractor or designer create a more accurate plan and estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have photos, measurements, inspiration images, and a list of what needs to change. The more detail you provide, the more accurate the estimate will be.
